items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: and Sam Beers was running the place.

ctx.x: Controlling, very much. And Bill kind of broke us up. And I went to live with Bill. So I started drifting away. But Win. opened that My Cellar, and he had on piano. Had nothing for me, and I came down there to visit. And I was just fortunate that the same night I came down, Bix came down. And I just sat there and listened.

And then, finally, this spotlight, there was one spotlight, and Sam Beers was running the place. B-e-e-r-s, he was the boss then that you might run into occasionally now in Annapolis or in Europe, the understanding man that puts the music first and the cash register second. It's a rarity, a tremendous rarity. The man that loves the arts.
So he had Wingy's band. And they spotlighted on Bix, and the whole audience was musicians. There might have been a couple of dancers that hung around.
